trailhead.label: The church of San Giorgio in Cislano, Zone, the published start

cautions: About 1.2 km of mountain path (T2) through the reserve: an earth path with steeper ups and downs, slippery after rain and dangerous in snow, as the board warns; sure footing needed.
The pyramids stand on steep, crumbling slopes: keep your dog on the path and close at the viewpoints.
Near the end the walk follows the provincial road to Zone for about 120 m, then lanes into Cislano: keep your dog on a short lead there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
